summary.intent: Trigger a release-please patch bump by correctly scoping a CI/Dockerfile fix commit.
summary.outcome: Commit was amended to fix(api) scope, which maps to the @cipherbox/api release-please component and should trigger a patch bump.

repo: release-please-config.json defines component scopes; fix(ci) does not map to any component and will not trigger a release.
The Dockerfile for the API lives in apps/api/, so the correct conventional commit scope is 'api' to attribute changes to @cipherbox/api.

code.finding: Modified as part of a CI fix; must use scope 'api' in commit message to trigger release-please patch bump.

workflow: Conventional commit scopes must exactly match release-please component names — generic scopes like 'ci' are silently ignored by release-please even if the commit type is 'fix'.
Force-pushing amended commits was used to correct commit message scope after the PR was already open.

friction: Initial fix(ci) scope was plausible but wrong — release-please silently skipped it with no obvious error, requiring config inspection to diagnose.
Required two force-push iterations (first to fix(ci), then to fix(api)) to land on the correct scope.
open_items: Verify that the fix(api) commit actually triggers the expected patch bump once the PR merges and release-please runs.
